test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 30th November 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution required’.

Vanilla ice cream __with chocolate sauce is__ my favourite.
solution:
The correct answer is -No substitution required.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is having no error. 
 
• The given sentence is grammatically correct sentence.
 
• The given sentence implies that Vanilla ice cream along with chocolate sauce is speaker's favourite.
 
• Here, the preposition with in the underlined segment is correct .
 
• Thus, the correct answer is option 2.
